title: Faithful archive of legacy prose experiment notes

scope.purpose: Preserve legacy human prose files before removing non-whitelisted prose from active repo paths.
scope.claim_boundary: This is faithful byte preservation by archive and manifest hashes. It is not a semantic conversion, summary, theorem claim, or source audit.
scope.normative_policy: Archived prose is historical material only. Future experiment history, lab notes, references, roadmaps, and working understandings must be JSON/CTL objective artifacts.

verification.prose_policy_enforcement: ctl-dogfood/scripts/verify.py now rejects loose non-whitelisted prose files

next_step.action: remove archived loose prose files after this objective note is admitted
next_step.safety_condition: script refuses to remove a file if its current sha256 differs from the manifest entry
